cited.what: R1 approaches the brown tray on the robotic table from above.

root_cause: R1's PP_TAB_CONV routine grips the tray open-loop (PulseDO DO_ATT_TAB followed only by WaitTime 0.25) without checking DI_GRIP_OK. When a grasp fails, the robot continues the place trajectory and commands DO_DET_TAB while holding nothing.

cited.what: R1 descends to the parts holder to pick red part AP3.

root_cause: R1 routine PP_TP_AB performs an open-loop pick (OBJECT_MANIP attach + WaitTime 0.25) without checking DI_GRIP_OK, so when a part pick misses or the part is displaced, R1 proceeds to the place trajectory and commands detach on an empty gripper.

cited.what: R2 reaches Target_TAB_CONV on the conveyor and pulses DO_SG_P and DO_ATT_TTAB, but the tray grasp fails (t=35.2s: T_R2 grip TRAY: FAILED).

root_cause: R2 routine PP_TAB_CONV executes an open-loop grasp (PulseDO DO_SG_P and DO_ATT_TTAB followed by WaitTime 0.25) without checking DI_GRIP_OK to verify that the tray is held before moving to the box and detaching.

cited.what: R2 moves to the box holder (BH) pick position at Target_INIT_H.

root_cause: R2's PP_TAB_H routine pulses DO_ATT_BH to vacuum-grip the box holder open-loop without checking DI_GRIP_OK, so when the grasp misses it continues to the place target and commands DO_DET_BH on an empty gripper.
